text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu♪ Birthdays really are the best! I 
got so many presents!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
A huge bouquet of flowers, the textbook 
I've been wanting to read, a custom 3-tier 
cake from my favorite patisserie♪ And even 
a beauty set from my dream brand!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, as expected of Ai-san...! Everyone's 
totally pumped up~!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: I had a present from me too... but, hmm...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
A-Actually, I made a plushie. But hearing 
that just now made me wonder if handmade 
stuff is really okay...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Handmade sounds wonderful! If Craft-chan 
made it, it's bound to be adorable!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Still, somehow... hmmmmm. ...Sorry, give 
me one more week. I'm gonna upgrade it!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Huh! You're not giving it to me today?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! With its current quality, it's not 
good enough for Ai-san!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
You really didn't have to. It's the 
thought that counts with these things, you 
know?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
No, no way! I won't have it! Anything I 
give to Ai-san has gotta be the absolute 
cuuute-est, or else!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, you really are so particular. Fine 
then, I'll wait! —I'm expecting great 
things, always.
